newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: BOLSWESSANEN TALKS ON U.S. BUY PROGRESS.
newsitem.headline: BOLSWESSANEN TALKS ON U.S. BUY PROGRESS.

text.p: Dutch food and drinks group BolsWessanen NV said on Monday talks on the acquisition of an unnamed U.S. specialty food distributor were well advanced.
"The company (in question) has a turnover of some $100 million. We expect to be able to give more details soon," BolsWessanen chairman Mac Zondervan told the meeting of shareholders.
The acquisition by Bols unit Tree of Life would fill the last remaining gap in the nationwide coverage of specialty foods and bolster Bols leadership in this segment, he said.
Bols said last month it was still looking for large acquisitions in the dairy sector, particularly in Europe, in convenience foods and in natural foods in the U.S.
Zondervan said at the time that a large purchase could be financed by disposals in other areas.
